died.name: Gruffudd ap Llywelyn ab Iorwerth
died.cause: The first-born son of Llywelyn the Great died while attempting to lower himself from the Tower of London in an escape attempt. The rope, made out of sheets and other fabrics, snapped, and his neck was broken in the fall, according to English monk and chronicler, Matthew Paris.

died.name: Thomas Forret
died.desc: vicar of Dollar, Clackmannanshire, burned for heresy
died.last_words: God be merciful to me, a sinner; Lord Jesus receive my spirit! Miserere mei Deus secundum magnam misericordiam tuam.

died.name: George Wishart
died.cause: kissing one of his executioners on the cheek after the man asked for his forgiveness
died.last_words: Lo! here is a token that I forgive thee; my heart, do thine office.

died.name: George Herbert
died.desc: Welsh-born poet, orator, and priest of the Church of England
died.last_words: I am now ready to die. Lord, forsake me not, now my strength faileth me; but grant me mercy for the merits of my Jesus. And now Lord-Lord, now receive my soul.

died.name: Francisco Solano López
died.cause: after his last stand in the Battle of Cerro Corá

died.name: Lucky Baldwin
died.last_words: By gad, I'm not licked yet.

died.name: Joseph Trumpeldor
died.cause: after being mortally wounded at the Battle of Tel Hai during the Battle of Tel Hai
died.last_words: "Never mind, it is good to die for our country." ("אין דבר, טוב למות בעד ארצנו")

died.name: Gabriele D'Annunzio
died.last_words: Stop-I turn home... I'm bored... I'm bored.

died.name: Harlon Block
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Iwo Jima

died.name: Lothar Sieber
died.cause: The 22-year-old Luftwaffe test pilot died while making the only manned test flight of the Bachem Ba 349 Natter vertical take-off bomber. On his fatal flight, Sieber became the first human to fly a vertically-launched rocket.

born.name: François Séverin Marceau
born.desc: French general of the Revolutionary Wars
born.cause: to General Jean-Baptiste Jourdan when mortally wounded at the Battle of Limburg (1796)
born.last_words: General, why do you shed tears? I am happy to die for my country.

born.name: James Cameron
born.desc: Union colonel of the American Civil War
born.cause: before being mortally wounded at the First Battle of Bull Run

born.name: Frédéric Chopin
born.cause: asked by his physician if he was suffering

born.name: Michael F. Farley
born.cause: The 58-year-old U.S. Representative and Gore–McLemore resolution supporter died of anthrax he contracted from his shaving brush.

born.name: Lytton Strachey
born.last_words: If this is dying, then I don't think much of it.

born.name: Ryūnosuke Akutagawa
born.last_words: Probably no one who attempts suicide-is fully aware of all his motives, which are usually too complex. At least in my case it is prompted by a vague sense of anxiety-about my own future. - As for my vague sense of anxiety about my own future, I think I analyzed it all in 'A Fool's Life,' except for a social factor, namely the shadow of feudalism cast over my life. This I omitted purposely, not at all certain that I could really clarify the social context in which I lived. - P.S. Reading a life of Empedocles, I felt how old is this desire to make a god of oneself. This letter, so far as I am conscious, never attempts this. On the contrary, I consider myself one of the most common humans. You may recall those days of twenty years ago when we discussed 'Empedocles on Etna'-under the linden trees. In those days I was one who wished to make a god of myself.

born.name: Norman F. Baesall
born.desc: U.S. Army Air Force lieutenant colonel
born.cause: in response to Glenn Miller asking where the parachutes were prior to flight from RAF Twinwood Farm to Paris. The plane disappeared while flying over the English Channel
born.last_words: What's the matter Miller, do you want to live forever?

born.name: Yitzhak Rabin
born.last_words: This rally must send a message to the Israeli people, to the Jewish people around the world, to the many people in the Arab world, and indeed to the entire world, that the Israeli people want peace, support peace. For this, I thank you.

born.name: Georgi Markov
born.cause: The Bulgarian dissident writer was poisoned on a London street via a micro-engineered pellet containing ricin, fired into his leg from an umbrella wielded by an assassin associated with the Bulgarian Secret Service. Markov died four days later in hospital. No one was ever charged with the assassination.

born.name: Donald Harding
born.cause: His asphyxiation in the gas chamber took 11 minutes before death was finally confirmed, and Harding spent his last moments cursing Arizona's state attorney general Grant Woods and giving him the middle finger
born.last_words: (Declined to make a final statement, but signaled the executioner to get started.)
